highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.147 previews Skia m147 with variable fonts, animated WebP encoding, and expanded modern platform support.
highlights_body: The v4 line adds color font palettes, direct stream data access, configurable surface sampling, and safer typeface and path lifecycles. Review the platform and API migrations before upgrading.

breaking.title: WebAssembly native assets now require .NET 8 or later
breaking.body: Native assets for the Emscripten versions used by .NET 6 and .NET 7 are removed. Move Blazor WebAssembly and Uno Platform WebAssembly applications to .NET 8 or later.

breaking.title: Tizen 32-bit native assets are removed
breaking.body: The m147 update drops the EOL Tizen arm and x86 builds and packages. Move Tizen deployments to the supported tizen-arm64 or tizen-x64 runtime identifiers.

breaking.title: Vulkan YCbCr conversion info uses the GR prefix
breaking.body: GRVkImageInfo.YcbcrConversionInfo now uses GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo. Update code to the correctly named type; the obsolete GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo shim remains for migration but no longer exposes its previous equality interface and operators.

breaking.title: SKStream.Move rejects offsets outside the native range
breaking.body: The obsolete SKStream.Move(long) overload now throws OverflowException instead of silently truncating values outside the 32-bit native range. Keep offsets within Int32 bounds and migrate away from the obsolete overload.

breaking.title: Null SKFont typefaces no longer resolve the default font
breaking.body: Passing null as an SKFont typeface produces an empty typeface under the updated engine. Pass SKTypeface.Default explicitly when text measurement or rendering requires the system default.

bullets.detail: Advances the bundled renderer across 28 upstream milestones, including newer image-codec, HDR, wide-gamut, raster, and filter behavior.

bullets.lead: Bundled image, font, and compression libraries refreshed
bullets.detail: Updates libjpeg-turbo to 3.1.4.1, FreeType to 2.14.3, zlib to 1.3.2.1, libpng to 1.6.58, and libexpat to 2.7.5.

bullets.lead: Variable and color fonts gain first-class APIs
bullets.detail: Adds variation-axis discovery and cloning, color font palette queries and overrides, HarfBuzz variation controls, and the correctly ordered HBColor value type.
SKWebpEncoder can encode single images or timed frame sequences through span-based stream overloads.
SKStream.GetData returns ref-counted backing data when the native stream can provide it directly.
New SKSurface.Draw and SKCanvas.DrawSurface overloads restore explicit texture-filtering control when compositing surfaces.

bullets.lead: Document, GPU, mask, and color-space APIs expanded
bullets.detail: Adds XPS document options, per-resource GPU flushes, shader mask filters, and CICP color-space creation.

bullets.lead: Font span operations and glyph checks corrected
bullets.detail: Handles undersized variation buffers correctly and fixes a recursive ContainsGlyphs overload that could overflow the stack.
Preserves the current surface dimensions when a GL view is reattached after tab switches or page navigation.

bullets.lead: Apple library targets accept the base Xcode 26 workload
bullets.detail: Packages now target the 26.0 platform versions instead of requiring Xcode 26.2.

bullets.lead: SKPath finalization no longer races its builder
bullets.detail: Prevents a finalizer-thread crash when an internal SKPathBuilder is collected before its owning path.

bullets.lead: Default typeface resolution is more resilient
bullets.detail: Moves default-font lookup into the managed layer, avoids Android startup crashes, and uses an empty typeface when no system font is available.

bullets.lead: NanoServer starts without a system font manager
bullets.detail: Uses an empty font manager on NanoServer instead of crashing during SKTypeface initialization.
Adds x64 and arm64 packages for Linux environments that use Android's Bionic libc.
Adds tizen-x64 and tizen-arm64 packages built against Tizen 8.0.

v4.147.0-preview.1.1.summary: Opens the v4 line on Skia m147 with variable and color fonts, CICP color spaces, surface sampling, refreshed PNG/XML libraries, Linux Bionic and 64-bit Tizen assets, and Android GL and typeface fixes. Tizen drops 32-bit assets; null SKFont typefaces become empty, and obsolete SKStream.Move rejects out-of-range offsets.

v4.147.0-preview.2.1.summary: Adds animated WebP encoding and SKStream.GetData, fixes the SKPath finalizer crash, and restores broad Xcode 26 compatibility for Apple packages.

v4.147.0-preview.3.1.summary: Adds HBColor, XPS creation, per-resource GPU flushes, and shader mask filters while refreshing bundled native libraries and preventing NanoServer font initialization crashes. WebAssembly native assets now require .NET 8 or later, and Vulkan YCbCr callers should migrate to GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp 8.3.1.6 adds variable-font controls, color palette queries, and the HBColor value type, alongside Linux Bionic and 64-bit Tizen native assets.
